scenes.script:
Rahul says: Saalon waste kar diye expensive English classes par, fir bhi interviews me freeze ho jata tha. Fir mujhe mili Supernova AI.
Rahul says: Ab mai Miss Nova ke saath privately speaking practice karta hoon. Wo mere liye ek custom plan banati hain aur meri mistakes ko kabhi judge nahi karti!
scenes.on_screen_text:
Top: Expensive English classes par paise waste karne ke baad bhi interviews me freeze hone wala mai.

Bottom: Supernova AI par Miss Nova ke saath privately speaking practice karne ke baad mai.

parsed.self_critique_fixed: Applied the Hindi module and global rules. The hook opens with the native word 'Saalon' to ensure a strong local thumbstop. Kept all key product terms like 'English classes', 'interviews', 'privately speaking practice', 'custom plan', and 'mistakes' in English to maintain the code-mixed, natural WhatsApp-style register. Addressed Miss Nova with respectful honorifics ('karti hain') to adhere to the politeness architecture. No Sanskritized or formal words were used, keeping the tone highly colloquial and relatable.

safety.summary: The ad is fully compliant with all brand-safety guardrails, featuring a safe shame-to-triumph resolution and emphasizing private, non-judgmental practice.
